name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LinearHop.hop_dichotomy
title: Linear embedding hop dichotomy: a functional either ignores the embedded challenge or sees it uniformly
statement: Let K be a finite field, U a finite K-module, V a K-module, L : U -> V linear, c in V and h a linear functional on V. If h o L = 0 then h(L b + c) = h(c) for every b (the decryption with functional h is the same in the real and the uniform branch of a reduction that embeds its challenge b as L b + c). If h o L != 0 then all fibers {u | h(L u + c) = z}, z in K, have the same size, i.e. for uniform u the value h(L u + c) is uniform on K (the decryption with functional h is destroyed in the uniform branch). Used in note pq-we-linear-hop-barrier.
